reason: Internal only; the Instagram social client is still not wired into composition (P5, now instagram_read), so nothing a member of a room can observe changes. InstagramSocialClient is rewritten to the instagram-bridge's real contract: story is GET /accounts/{igid}/story (found true -> ok, found false -> nothing_found), profile is GET /accounts/{igid} (the handler's own 404 -> nothing_found), 409/503 and everything else -> unavailable; the old POST /social/story and its status envelope, which the bridge never had, are gone. A story result carries each frame's text layer (caption, Instagram's alt text, author) per design 18, rendered only inside the untrusted wrap and clamp, never into items or note; profile is newly served, rendered the same way, and says when the bio/privacy half could not be read. posts stays unserved. The igid is shape-checked (int64 width) before it enters a URL path. Shared contract fixtures in tests/fixtures/instagram_bridge are generated by the Go handlers (deploy/instagram-bridge/contract_fixtures_test.go, -update) and read by the Python tests, so a shape change on either side fails on both. All fixture values are synthetic.
